notes: Fixed the extension's own update checker: it was pointed at a dead Vercel alias (leadloftexporter.vercel.app — the same stale host that caused the SMTP relay outage), so lcCheckForUpdate() silently failed on every install and nobody ever saw an "update available" badge, no matter how out of date they were. Also fixed the Backend URL host permission and the Content Hub "Push to Extension" content script, which were both still scoped to that same dead host and so never worked on the real site. All three now point at leads.hudace.com.
